items.html:
A highly thought of quick bowler who attends school in England at Oakham, his 5 for 23 against Namibia in an ICC Trophy warm-up game in England announced his arrival to the Bermudan public. His best ODI performance to date came against Scotland in the World Cricket League match where they secured their only win of the competition and he took 3 for 47 from his 10 overs including the prize wicket of Gavin Hamilton. He bowls at a medium fast pace and will need to build himself up if he is going to add an extra yard of pace. When batting he displays a solid technique and is capable of holding up an end but he will need to work on that aspect of his game.
Alan Curr February 2007
